name: Implement, Review, Fix
summary: A bounded implementation loop with worker output, adversarial review, repair, and verifier-backed closeout.

combo.description: Build, adversarially review, repair if requested, verify, and close with evidence.

phases.title: Frame Mission State
phases.action: Inspect mission queues, open gates, existing runtime runs, and verifier coverage before delegation.
phases.verifier: Operator confirms the next delegation target and objective verifier.
phases.stop_condition: Mission has a clear implement scope, review scope, and verifier.

phases.title: Delegate Implementation
phases.action: Launch or assign a bounded implementation worker.
phases.verifier: Worker report exists, but integrated work is not yet verified.
phases.stop_condition: Worker report has changed files, commands run, limits, and risks.

phases.title: Opposite-Brand Review
phases.action: Run the opposite reviewer brand against the implementation.
phases.command: uaf adversarial-review --from codex --brand {{combo_brand}} --mission {{mission_id}} --scope "<scope>" --prompt "Review this implementation for blockers, regressions, missing tests, and UAF closeout gaps." --profile {{profile}} --timeout-ms 1800000
phases.verifier: Reviewer verdict is recorded and orchestrator decision accepts, rejects, or requests changes.
phases.stop_condition: Review findings are triaged by the orchestrator.

phases.title: Repair Findings
phases.action: Address blocker findings or explicitly defer non-blocking follow-ups.
phases.verifier: Blockers are fixed or moved to accepted risk with human approval.

phases.title: Run Objective Verifiers
phases.action: Run the configured verifier that proves the integrated change.

phases.title: Close and Promote
phases.action: Close the task with evidence and promote durable lessons only if reusable.
phases.verifier: Completion references supporting evidence and uaf check passes.
phases.stop_condition: Task is closed or explicitly blocked.
